How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Delhi Research Associate Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Delhi to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the AIIMS Delhi Research Associate position is 05-08-2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Nursing, Public Health, or Allied Health Sciences to be eligible for the Research Associate position at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate position is 35 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules, which can be found in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 60,000.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate position at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate recruitment at AIIMS Delhi primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the AIIMS Delhi Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for the AIIMS Delhi Research Associate recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official AIIMS Delhi website.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Research Associate position at AIIMS Delhi is a contractual job. The duration and terms of the contract will be specified in the official appointment letter.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification and the online application link are provided in the "Important Links" section of this article. You can also visit the official AIIMS Delhi website for more details.
